text: SOLIZE Holdings Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Standard Market (stock code 5871). Its FY2025 annual securities report lists its major shareholders, as of December 31, 2025, as the SOLIZE Employee Stock Ownership Association (21.08%), Miyuki Furukawa (14.09%), Keiichi Shinohara (6.44%) and Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Development Co., Ltd. (5.60%).
short: SOLIZE Holdings is TSE-listed (5871); top holder is its employee stock association
